p: iniquity had an end: When by their punishment I called them from their iniquity.
hated blood: Except you repent your former cruelty.
return: That is, to their former estate.
These two nations and these two: Meaning, Israel and Judah.
there: And so by fighting against God's people they should go about to put him out of his own possession.
anger: As you have done cruelly, so will you be cruelly handled.

them: Showing that when God punishes the enemies, the godly ought to consider that he has a care over them and so praise his name: and also that the wicked rage as though there were no God, till they feel his hand to their destruction.
